Job Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Experience: 1-3 years
Location: Hybrid: Mumbai, 3 days a week in the office.
Mandatory Skills:
- Python
- pandas
- Deep Learning

Good to have:
- SQL
- MLflow
- TensorFlow
- Natural Language Processing

Responsibilities:
- Join a growing applied ML team at LumaSense Analytics, a startup building AI-driven insights for enterprise document and customer-communication workflows.
- Design, develop and maintain production-ready deep learning models for tasks such as classification, sequence modeling and representation learning using Python and pandas for data preprocessing and feature engineering.
- Collaborate with data engineers to ingest, clean and transform large structured and unstructured datasets; implement robust pipelines for training and evaluation.
- Build model training, evaluation and deployment artifacts; track experiments and model versions and participate in establishing ML lifecycle best practices (MLflow experience is a plus).
- Work with engineers to productionize models, integrate TensorFlow or other frameworks as needed, and ensure scalable inference in cloud or on-prem environments.
- Contribute to NLP-focused initiatives (information extraction, semantic search, text classification) when required and apply deep learning techniques to improve model accuracy and efficiency.
- Write clear documentation, unit tests and reproducible notebooks; participate in code reviews and cross-functional planning with product and QA teams.
- Monitor model performance in production, diagnose issues, and implement retraining and model-update strategies to maintain business KPIs.
